verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs claim a modern 3D renderer with lights, shadows, materials, contact shadows, and custom shaders and materials, so the shadow and material parts of the story are first-party documented. The pack never names PBR, global illumination or baked lighting, or post-processing. Community reports of aliasing and jagged, low-res shadows question rendering quality but do not contradict that the features exist. Missing for 10: explicit PBR material docs, global illumination or baked lighting evidence, post-processing evidence, independent corroboration of production-grade shadow quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: Features: lights, shadows, cameras, meshes, textures, materials, gltf loading
Extensible: custom shaders, materials, and render pipelines
